name: teams-hud-live-edit
description: M19 U2 acceptance (X-rider W2): teams overrode cards/diff/todo/thinking/error but NOT the trait edit_message, so it was absent from EDIT_CAPABLE_CHANNELS, got no live HUD, and every 'edit' became new-message spam. U2 added the trait edit_message override + put teams in EDIT_CAPABLE_CHANNELS. Now the Task HUD runs LIVE: it posts ONE breadcrumb chip at the first tool call and edits that ONE message in place on every later frame instead of posting N. The harness models teams' real edit-in-place via model_rich_breadcrumbs; replay.rs asserts exactly one breadcrumb post + >=1 edit, all targeting that single anchor. See README.md.
